subject: SeedBank condensed compliance walk-through — 30min slot request
body:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@seedbank.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Jun 2029 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: SeedBank condensed compliance walk-through — 30min slot request

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for the quick intake last week. Per our conversation, we'd like to schedule a concise 30-minute compliance walk-through covering: SOC 2 scope overview, DPA confirmation, and pen-test handoff expectations. The goal is to keep this a tight ops briefing for your security and procurement teams.

Here are three short windows we can offer (all in BST):
- Wed 19 Jun, 14:00–14:30
- Thu 20 Jun, 17:00–17:30 (evening slot, good for APAC folks)
- Mon 24 Jun, 09:00–09:30

Ben and Laura are cc'd for capacity; if any of these work please confirm and we’ll send a calendar invite with a lightweight agenda.

Attachments: redwood_agenda_30min.pdf (pdf) — draft agenda; seedbank_SOW.pdf (pdf) — referenced SOW for scope alignment.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Security & Compliance Ops
Redwood Inference

--
On Wed, 19 Jun 2029 at 10:05, Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@seedbank.io> wrote:

> Thanks Kimberly — appreciate the concise options.
> 
> Thu 20 Jun 17:00–17:30 BST would be best for our security leads (Tracy will join). We will also pull in our pen-test vendor (third-party) for the 10–15 minute handoff segment if that’s okay.
> 
> One question: do you expect any pre-reading beyond the agenda? We can circulate internally if helpful.
> 
> — Jordan
> Security Lead, SeedBank

On Thu, 19 Jun 2029 at 11:12, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai> wrote:

> Jordan / Kimberly —
> 
> Thu 20 Jun 17:00 BST works for me and for Laura. We’re happy to keep this to 30 minutes; suggested split: 12 minutes SOC2 scope + controls mapping, 8 minutes DPA/processing notes, 10 minutes pen-test handoff and Q&A.
> 
> Pre-reading: the draft agenda is sufficient. If SeedBank can share the current DPA redline or vendor details ahead of time that would speed the handoff.
> 
> FYI I’ll own the SOC2 controls section; Laura will cover evidence transfer/process.
> 
> -Ben
> Sr. Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference

On Thu, 20 Jun 2029 at 08:17, Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@seedbank.io> wrote:

> Ben — thanks. Tracy (cc’d on follow-up) has attached the vendor contact and a short DPA summary.
> 
> One minor hitch: our procurement team just flagged a DocuSign step for the SOW; could we move the slot 30 minutes later if possible? If you can’t, we can keep 17:00 and Tracy will hop on early to handle the procurement items.
> 
> Attachment: seedbank_vendor_contact.vcard (vcard)
> 
> — Jordan

On Sun, 23 Jun 2029 at 16:02, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai> wrote:

> Hi Jordan / Tracy / Ben / Laura —
> 
> Quick update: Laura and I can shift the meeting 30 minutes later on Thu 20 Jun to accommodate the DocuSign SOW step. Confirmed new time: Thu 20 Jun, 17:30–18:00 BST. I’ve sent a calendar invitation and included a short bridge (Google Meet) and the final agenda.
> 
> Final checklist before the call:
> - SeedBank: share the DPA redline (if available) or high-level exceptions (Tracy)
> - Bring pen-test vendor contact details for the handoff (Jordan)
> - Redwood: we will share the evidence map doc link during the call and a post-call summary with next steps.
> 
> Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=seedbank-brief-20290623
> Doc pack: https://docsend.com/seeds/seedbank-prep-pack
> 
> Thanks everyone — we’ll keep this tight.
> 
> Best,
> Kimberly
>
>--
>
> On Sun, 23 Jun 2029 at 16:15, Tracy Mullins <tracy.mullins@seedbank.com> wrote:
> 
> > Confirmed — 17:30–18:00 BST works for us. DocuSign step completed and I uploaded the current DPA redline to the DocSend link above. Pen-test vendor (VulnOps) will join for the final 10 minutes.
> > 
> > Thanks for accommodating the shift. See you Thursday.
> > 
> > — Tracy
> > Head of Security, SeedBank
